snippet.title: Cartoon Survivor | Official Steam Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Get 40% off the first two worlds for a limited time: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3378190/Cartoon_Survivor/

Survive the wildest adventure of your life in Cartoon Survivor! Run, jump, and glide through a vibrant prehistoric world filled with dangerous creatures and crazy obstacles. Can you outlast the chaos and save the show? It’s time to prove you’ve got what it takes!
